name: northunity
description: NorthUnity — Tamil-first membership PWA for the Northern Province, Sri Lanka
comment: This root manifest exists for the serverless deployment. Vercel installs
from the repository root, and api/[...path].js pulls in server/src, so the
API's runtime dependencies have to be resolvable from here. They are kept
identical to server/package.json — update both together.
The frontend keeps its own manifest in app/ and is built by buildCommand in
vercel.json. Nothing is installed from app/ at the root.
